summary: Backend testing complete - All 81 tests passed (60 existing + 21 new iteration 5 tests). Comprehensive testing of match duration customization (10-180 minutes), timer controls (start/stop/reset), and manual lineup override with team validation.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ MatchCreate accepts duration_minutes (default=60, ge=10, le=180) - validated via Pydantic
✅ POST /api/matches persists duration_minutes to match document and returns it in response
✅ GET /api/matches/{id} returns duration_minutes, timer_started_at (null initially), timer_ended_at (null initially)
✅ POST /api/matches/{id}/timer/start sets timer_started_at=<ISO datetime now>, timer_ended_at=null
✅ POST /api/matches/{id}/timer/stop sets timer_ended_at=<ISO datetime now>, preserves timer_started_at
✅ POST /api/matches/{id}/timer/reset clears both timer_started_at and timer_ended_at (sets to null)
✅ All timer endpoints (start/stop/reset) require editor role via require_editor dependency
✅ Non-editor users receive 403 Forbidden on all timer endpoints
✅ PUT /api/matches/{id}/lineup accepts LineupOverrideIn schema: {team_a, team_b, team_c, reserves} as user_id arrays
✅ Lineup override rehydrates each user_id into player object with {user_id, name, shirt_number, profile_picture, preferred_position, rating, vote}
✅ Original vote preserved if user had voted, defaults to 'yes' otherwise
✅ Lineup override validates no duplicate user across teams (400 error with descriptive message)
✅ Lineup override enforces team_size cap on team_a, team_b, team_c (400 error if exceeded)
✅ Reserves array has no size limit (can hold overflow players)
✅ Lineup override with team_c containing players auto-sets match.third_team_enabled=true
✅ Lineup override with empty arrays works (can reset/clear lineup)
✅ Lineup override sets status='scheduled' if match was in 'voting' status
✅ PUT /api/matches/{id}/lineup requires editor role (403 for non-editors)
✅ No regressions - all 60 existing tests still pass (auth, forgot-password, users, config, matches, league, lineup algorithm)
seed_data_creation: Tests create unique users per test run using timestamp-based email addresses (TEST_*_{timestamp}@clubdodo.com). Admin user (admin@clubdodo.com / dodo2026) is seeded on startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 adds: (1) duration_minutes field to matches (10-180 range, default 60) for customizable match length. (2) Timer controls: POST /matches/{id}/timer/start, /timer/stop, /timer/reset (all editor-only) to manage match timer state (timer_started_at, timer_ended_at ISO datetime strings). (3) Manual lineup override: PUT /matches/{id}/lineup (editor-only) accepts {team_a, team_b, team_c, reserves} as user_id arrays, rehydrates with user details, validates no duplicates across teams, enforces team_size caps, auto-enables third_team if team_c has players. All features working correctly with proper authorization checks.
